nodes.title: Start here
widgets_values:
# Premiere round trip -- one button, the whole loop

**This one needs the ComfyUI Bridge panel running in Premiere.** It *is* the panel round trip: a frame goes out, an inverted frame comes back. Demos 01, 02 and 03 need no Premiere at all -- start there if you haven't installed the panel yet.

**1.** In Premiere, open a sequence and park the playhead on the frame you want.

**2.** In the ComfyUI Bridge panel, click **Frame -> ComfyUI**. The frame's path lands in the **Frame from Premiere** node below *and the workflow runs by itself* -- there is nothing to press here. (Prefer pressing Run yourself? Turn off **Run the workflow when Premiere sends a frame or clip**, under **Settings > Premiere Bridge**.)

**3.** In Premiere, open the **ComfyUI Results** bin.

**Success looks like:** one new clip called `inverted frame`, with obviously, unmistakably inverted colours. That single clip proves both directions at once -- the frame got out, the result got back in.

**If the run finishes and nothing appears**, look at the Send to Premiere node. It grows a status line labelled `✓ Premiere` when the hand-off worked and `⚠ Premiere` when it didn't, and a failure also raises a warning toast carrying the full path of the file it saved, so you can import that by hand. It never fails quietly.

nodes.title: What to change
widgets_values:
## What to change

**Swap the invert.** Invert Image Colors is a placeholder. Put any image workflow in its place -- the two Premiere nodes on either side are the only parts that have to stay.

**insert_at_playhead** is off, the safe default: results land only in the bin. Switch it on and the result also drops onto your open sequence at the playhead, as one undo step.

**The unused outputs.** Frame from Premiere also gives you `width`, `height` and `path`. Wire them up when your workflow needs to know the frame's real size.

**Clips work the same way.** The panel's **Clip -> ComfyUI** button drives *Clip from Premiere*, which has a VIDEO output you can send straight back. That's `05_clip_from_premiere.json`.

**One machine, both sides.** The panel and ComfyUI trade file paths, not file contents, so they have to be looking at the same disk.
